categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies depends/packages/sqlite.mk to add -DSQLITE_SECURE_DELETE compile flag.
categories.rationale: Enabling a compile flag in depends is an ancillary configuration change for wallet data security rather than a build system concern. It does not affect release integrity, toolchain compatibility, or CI reliability.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes SQLite wallet database initialization in src/wallet/sqlite.cpp, modifies WalletDatabase interfaces, and adds functional tests for wallet key erasure.
categories.rationale: Prevents sensitive key residues from remaining in unallocated database pages after passphrase rotation and deletions. As noted in the description, changing the passphrase previously left obsolete encryption key records in SQLite free space, compromising the confidentiality guarantees of wallet encryption against raw disk inspection.
